 # 🛠️ Hud Editor

## 🧱 Customization
This editor lets you customize your HUD however you want.
HudEditor is module based, now available:
 - Ping
 - Bps
 - Coords
 - Keyboard
 - Welcomer
 - Time
 - Hp
 - Inventory
 - Totem
 - Armor

You can create your ideal setup for PvP or a minimalist display of coordinates and FPS for basic survival.

## 🎨 Style
HudEditor also offers a high degree of customization for the appearance of the modules themselves, allowing you to create exactly the style you've always wanted!
Now avalable:
 - Colorpicker

## 💾 Config system
You can also save what you've created using the configuration system!
All configuration is done through a visual interface, so you won't have to write out lengthy configuration files!
